svg.title: One warp, three destinations
svg.desc: At the top, the room as the game draws it, with the path from the sanctum's steps down to the bottom edge. The way down from Sol Sanctum's entrance has three rows in the warp table, read from the top. The first leads to Vale, and is taken until the sanctum erupts. The second leads to Vale during the eruption, and is taken until the party leaves Vale. The third leads to Vale, with no condition. The first row whose condition still holds is taken, so the same path leads to Vale before the eruption, to Vale erupting while the story is there, and to Vale again for the rest of the game.

g.text: The party takes the way down
The rows are read from the top, and the first
whose condition still holds is taken. The same
path leads to Vale, then to Vale erupting, then
